_comment: MorletDB WinCC OA adapter: example configuration. Copyright 2026 MorletDB contributors. Apache-2.0.
Experimental, awaiting validation in WinCC OA. Keys beginning with '_' are comments.
Defaults follow docs/winccoa.md, section Defaults. Relative paths are relative to this file.
Asset names and datapoint elements must match the companion's [[assets]] and [[datapoints]].

companion._token_file: mode 0600, owned by the user WinCC OA runs as; a copy of the companion's current token

namespace._what: datapoints Morlet_Adapter (status) and Morlet_Inv_<slot> (investigations); created by bootstrap.js

_time_format: temporal: nanoseconds (WinccoaTimeFormat.Temporal); date or number: milliseconds

subscription._unconfirmed: Which of these attributes the JavaScript API delivers is UNCONFIRMED (API.md); verify in phase C.
